summary: Missoula County, MT platform tower from the 1920s; firelookout.com and the FFLA list both call it abandoned, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned, not as destroyed or removed; no source says whether the platform still stands

evidence.supports: built in the 1920s as a 20-foot platform tower; abandoned
agency named as Flathead National Forest
FFLA lists the structure as a platform with status abandoned, at coordinates 46.95496, -113.66395

corrections.why: Both sources say abandoned. Neither says the platform was removed, destroyed or burned, so 'gone' is not supported.

notes_for_editor: Only two pages and no second description. The build date is a decade (1920s), so no built event with a year is recorded. The record's status 'gone' conflicts with both sources' 'abandoned' (see corrections). The forest name Flathead NF comes from firelookout.com alone and sits oddly with a Missoula County location; worth a check against a forest map. Height 6.1 m is the page's 20-foot figure, not confirmed as deck height. No staffing or fire information found.
